comment: Single source of truth for the music score and the SFX track on the 300s Ep21 timeline. This episode is IMAGE-BASED (Ken-Burns motion on player stills) — there are NO generated video clips, so the `clips` array is empty. mux.mjs mixes the music cues (looped/trimmed, ducked under Brian's VO) and any ElevenLabs sound-design hits in sfx/ (skipped gracefully if not yet generated). Music plan per README: Crossing the Chasm, Desert City, Five Armies, Invariance — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC-BY 4.0.

music.comment: Four-cue film score. Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC-BY 4.0 — credit required in the YouTube description (see README). The Dancing Lion mystery segment (271-288.5) deliberately drops the heavy bed: only the heroic cue swells under Brian.

sfx.comment: ElevenLabs sound-design hits (sfx/*.mp3). These files are generated alongside the VO; mux.mjs skips any that are missing, so the NO_VO music preview still works before they exist. Whooshes ride the scene transitions; the rest mark story beats.
